title: Coolisses
description: The app that helps you discover new musicians in a different way
descriptionWithMark: The app that helps you <mark>discover new musicians</mark> in a different way

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: Coolisses is the intimate app that lets you <mark>discover emerging artists through their creative process</mark> while taking the time to build a special bond with them.
sections.team:
Designers: Lou CARDON
Developers: Françoise PHAM, César SAINT-LO
sections.role:
Helped develop the concept
Helped design and prototype the user experience and interface
Wrote and ran the usability tests

sections.label: Brief
sections.title: Designing an app...
sections.paragraph: For this project, we had to design an app with <mark>innovative interactions.</mark> We had to start from a type of everyday app, music apps, and create a concept that gives the user a <mark>new way of approaching the subject</mark>.

sections.label: Benchmark
sections.title: Music apps: our analysis
sections.paragraph:
Analyzing the best-known music apps, we realized that many were centered on the player and that they almost exclusively recommended artists people already knew.

We also found that the suggestions were heavily dependent on the user's existing listening habits, keeping them in their comfort zone and preventing them from experimenting with new genres or artists.

sections.title: Framing the problem
sections.paragraph: So we asked ourselves <mark>how we could broaden our musical horizons</mark> when player apps deliberately keep us in a musical echo chamber.

sections.label: Concept
sections.title: The pitch
sections.paragraph: The concept we drew from this question is to introduce music lovers to <mark>young artists</mark> <mark>through their creative process</mark> via an <mark>intimate app</mark> that lets them <mark>take their time and build a special bond with the artists.</mark>

sections.caption: An app that takes you behind the scenes with emerging artists.

sections.title: Target audiences
sections.paragraph: The app is aimed equally at <mark>music lovers</mark> and <mark>emerging musical artists,</mark> letting the former discover new artists and the latter get noticed.

sections.caption: Personas explaining the project's two target audiences.

sections.title: What type of content?
sections.paragraph: We drew inspiration from a specific type of content and designed the app to host it: <mark>short, vertical videos showing artists behind the scenes,</mark> especially their music-making process.

sections.title: A distinctive tone
sections.paragraph:
We wanted the app to offer an intimate yet respectful experience, made of gentle information and contemplative exploration.

To do this, we drew inspiration from several apps that embody some of these principles, notably meditation apps.

sections.caption: A few apps that inspired the experience we created.

sections.title: Project scope
sections.paragraph: Our concept includes two apps: the first for the general public to discover new artists, the second for the artists themselves to share their content. Given the limited duration of this project, we focused on the public-facing app, as it best illustrates our concept.

sections.label: Design process
sections.title: User experience
sections.paragraph:
We built the app around one core feature: discovering one random artist per day.

We started by mapping out the features we wanted to develop to bring our concept and vision to life.

sections.caption: Map of the screens and features.

sections.paragraph: We then used this map to create <mark>wireframes,</mark> showing how elements are positioned on the app's screens.

sections.caption: The wireframes of the app's screens.

title: Violet
description: Illustrating the symbolism of a color

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph:
How do you visually represent the symbolism of a color? That was the central question of this project.
My partner and I tried, through a 30-second short film, to represent the symbolism of our chosen color: violet.
sections.role:
Contributed to ideation and filming
Video editing and sound design

sections.label: Research
sections.title: The symbolism of violet
sections.paragraph: To start, we gathered everything that <mark>made us think of violet</mark> and its symbolism.

sections.caption: Moodboard showing the different symbolisms of violet.

sections.label: Ideation
sections.title: Illustrating a symbolism
sections.paragraph: Drawing on the different symbolisms of violet, we explored <mark>various ideas for visual representations.</mark> Four scenes emerged, which we then filmed.

sections.label: Editing
sections.title: Putting the pieces together
sections.paragraph:
Once filming was done, I collected and sorted all the takes and then assembled them. This is also when I created the magic sphere.
I also added the small sounds that build a sound atmosphere supporting the visual representation.

sections.label: Final video
sections.title: An animated illustration...
sections.paragraph: This process allowed us to <mark>represent the symbolism of violet</mark> through visual, animated and sound elements, while <mark>immersing the viewer in the world of this color.</mark>

sections.caption: Short film on the symbolism of violet.

sections.title: Retrospective
sections.paragraph: By going through every stage of making a video, this project gave me a full picture of the process while letting me deepen my mastery of After Effects.
